Name: Twelve Hearts for Elliott
Author: Tarlonniel
Description:
Under chapter 42 of the Stardew Valley penal code, the lack of a twelve heart event is punishable by a fine of up to one prismatic shard or thirty days in the sewers with Krobus. So far this statute hasn't been enforced, but just to be sure that Elliott is safe from such a horrible fate, I've decided to provide him with the event he's been sorely lacking all these years.

Should be fully compatible with patch 1.5 and the various Elliott dialogue mods out there. More Elliott for everyone! [i]All[/i] the Elliott!

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. Not valid with any other offer. Some restrictions may apply. Please use Elliott responsibly.

Downloads.Description: And now, folks, what you've all been waiting for! Or not. Either way, here it is.
